propositions: 17 duplicate ADR numbers exist across 91 files (22 collisions), caused by stale-base races and in-flight Gerrit races; pre-merge CI checks cannot prevent this without false positives, but per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/ produce add/add conflicts that Rebase-If-Necessary cannot auto-resolve

22 duplicate-numbered ADRs must be renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order, with earliest-landed ADRs keeping their original numbers, and a RENUMBERING.md mapping must record the old-to-new assignments and per-reference resolution tier (slug-exact, topic-matched, ancestry, or UNRESOLVED)

All slug-bearing cross-references to moved ADRs in docs/ and src/ must be rewritten to their new 0070-0091 numbers, validated by scripts/check_adr_numbers.py which enforces referential integrity and fails on dangling adr/NNNN-slug markdown links

A generated docs/adr/README.md index grouped by workstream and a referential-integrity CI gate in scripts/check_adr_numbers.py (bijection between ADRs and marker files, unique numbers, unique marker content, resolvable cross-references) must be added to _build-and-test.yml
Moved ADRs must carry a header noting their previous number; kept ADRs must carry a note of the ambiguity window during which collisions existed
Bare ADR references (prose without slug) that cannot be mechanically bound to a single ADR remain advisory-only and are recorded as UNRESOLVED in RENUMBERING.md
